name: Airlock Keeper
description: An abandoned orbital station is still broadcasting from its airlock systems. Recover the protected emergency manifest from the station’s reachable systems on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-172.20.0.199.

tasks.name: Recover the emergency manifest
tasks.description: Investigate the abandoned airlock systems on the lab network and recover the protected emergency manifest. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-172.20.0.199.
hints: Compare the reachable services and notice which one offers a human-readable maintenance note.
The note points to credentials for a Redis service. Try authenticating with those credentials.
After logging in, read the airlock:manifest record.
